outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative bright-field and fluorescence photographs of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid for each mouse.
Panel C shows histology, fluorescence, RNAscope images, and spatial transcriptomic maps, not summary plots of averaged data requiring individual points.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), which are exempt from requiring individual data points.

Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold-change values (an averaged/summary statistic from differential expression analysis) for each gene, but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot or per-cell expression values) are overlaid.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged data.
